questions.q: Money from which sources did Quraysh reject for building the Kaaba?
questions.explain: Quraysh refused unlawful funds. Rebuilding needs pure funds.

questions.q: What was bought from the Roman ship stranded at Jeddah?
options: Stone, timber and the architect Bakum
questions.explain: A ship meant for a church was stranded and its materials were used for the Kaaba.

questions.q: Why was the demolition finally started by Al-Walid?
options: Because Abu Talib told him to
After no punishment came that night
questions.explain: Others waited a day before continuing.

questions.q: What changes were made to the form of the Kaaba after Quraysh rebuilt it?
options: It was made smaller, given a roof and its door raised
questions.explain: Hijr Ismail was set aside, the Kaaba was roofed and its door raised.

options: The area between the Black Stone and the Kaaba door, a place where prayer is answered
questions.explain: The Multazam is a place of answered prayer.

questions.q: What does the ustaz advise about kissing the Black Stone?
options: No need to push or hurt others; one may point with the hand
questions.explain: The Black Stone is only a stone.

questions.q: Each tribe held a corner of the cloth and the Prophet SAW placed the Black Stone.
questions.explain: True. An inclusive solution with no one left out.

questions.q: The inside of the Kaaba was filled with idols.
questions.explain: False. The interior of the Kaaba is empty apart from pillars.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: The Prophet SAW resolves it with a cloth
The Kaaba is fragile and robbed
The dispute over the Black Stone

questions.explain: The Kaaba was fragile, pure funds were gathered, Al-Walid began, the dispute arose, and the Prophet SAW resolved it with a cloth.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: Preservation, not tearing down and rebuilding
The expression "he has been cut off"
The semicircular fenced area beside the Kaaba

questions.explain: Qad batara is "he has been cut off", restoration is preservation, Al-Amin is the most trustworthy, and Hijr Ismail is the semicircular enclosure.

questions.q: You must settle a dispute between several groups. What example does the Prophet SAW give?
options: A solution that involves all parties
questions.explain: With the cloth, every tribe took part.
